graph.name: Orion Health Digital Front Door Architecture
graph.notes: Orion Health's Digital Front Door (DFD) architecture uses Amazon Kendra for NLP-powered searching across millions of healthcare documents, combining built-in static crawling and custom Lambda dynamic web crawling via S3.

nodes.name: DFD Website
nodes.notes: Digital Front Door patient web portal providing 24/7 access to health information and services.

nodes.name: CMS
nodes.notes: Content Management System storing website content for DFD Website.

nodes.name: Search UI
nodes.notes: Web search component embedded in the DFD Website.

nodes.name: Advisor Portal
nodes.notes: Clinician web portal for managing patient records and pre-filtering care.

nodes.name: Health Information Platform
nodes.notes: Backend platform containing clinician patient records.

nodes.name: API Gateway
nodes.notes: Exposes Amazon Kendra search index APIs to the Search UI.

nodes.name: Kendra
nodes.notes: Amazon Kendra intelligent search index scaling across 1M+ healthcare documents with natural language processing.

nodes.name: Static Resource
nodes.notes: Static web resources directly crawled by Kendra's built-in web crawler.

nodes.name: S3
nodes.notes: Amazon S3 bucket storing dynamic crawled documents for Kendra ingestion.

nodes.name: Dynamic Resource
nodes.notes: Dynamic healthcare websites and resources crawled by custom Lambda worker.

nodes.name: Lambda
nodes.notes: Custom serverless crawler fetching dynamic web resources and populating S3.

nodes.name: DynamoDB
nodes.notes: DynamoDB database acting as a state store and queue for the Lambda crawler.

edges.notes: DFD Website pulls content from CMS.
Advisor Portal pulls patient records from Health Information Platform.
DFD Website embeds Search UI component.
Kendra search index provides query capabilities via API Gateway (1M+ documents).
API Gateway feeds Kendra search results to Search UI.
Custom Lambda crawler fetches data from dynamic web resources.
Lambda custom crawler uses DynamoDB as a queue and state manager.
Lambda stores extracted dynamic documents into S3 bucket.
Kendra seamlessly pulls crawled dynamic documents from S3 into search index.
Kendra built-in web crawler directly crawls static resources.
